claim: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 baseline achieved higher R@1 and MRR than ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 on held-out Zeiss Gemini benchmark
statistical_method: Exact ranking evaluation over N=212 queries
limitations: ResNet-50 achieved higher R@5 and R@10 (1.0000 vs 0.9906); superior fine-grained patch localization not directly measured

claim: DINOv2 patch tokens retain higher microstructural discriminability than CLS token alone
limitations: Evaluated on static frozen ViT patch tokens without spatial cross-attention re-weighting

claim: Conditioning visual representations on evaluated metadata configuration using a gated MLP reduced retrieval performance on this benchmark
dataset: Zeiss GeminiSEM with 7 standardized metadata features
action: Causality not directly proven; failure mechanism is a hypothesized feature space confounding rather than proven instrument interference

claim: Zero-shot transfer to biological TEM yields moderate retrieval retention that improves under fine-tuning
limitations: Preliminary biological domain subset; does not cover cryo-TEM or electron diffraction contrast

claim: The model showed retrieval degradation under controlled synthetic image perturbations
dataset: Zeiss GeminiSEM test queries with synthetic corruptions
recomputed_value: Clean=0.9434, JPEG50=0.9057, Scalebar=0.8491, Contrast=0.7264, Noise=0.6038, Blur=0.4528
limitations: Synthetic perturbations are mathematical approximations, not direct hardware microscope failure measurements; clean baseline 0.9434 corresponds to B4 seed42

claim: An engineering stress test evaluated FAISS vector-index latency and throughput up to 100K vectors on host CPU hardware
dataset: Synthetic replicated vector index based on DINOv2 embeddings
statistical_method: Repeated query execution benchmark (100 query runs)
limitations: Engineering stress test using synthetic replicated vectors, NOT a scientific validation on a 100K-image real microscopy corpus; runtime subject to host OS thread scheduling

claim: Forensic analysis categorized 11 false nearest neighbor benchmark errors across four structural failure modes
limitations: Evaluates false nearest neighbors against designated benchmark positive class; does not imply image is scientifically invalid in a metallurgical context

claim: Double-blind review across 100 stratified review-queue triage events showed substantial inter-annotator agreement
dataset: Stratified review queue samples from Carinthia and HCCI repositories
metric: Cohen's Kappa; Percent Agreement; Review Duration
statistical_method: Pairwise Cohen's Kappa between 2 blind raters
action: Categories reflect expert-identified novelty/quality cases rather than pre-existing objective physical ground truth; consensus reached post-hoc with adjudicator

claim: Nearest-neighbor retrieval-score margin heuristic exhibits score compression and limited discriminative calibration
limitations: Raw score margin is not a calibrated confidence probability; AUROC ~0.515 represents an empirical negative finding regarding margin-based uncertainty

claim: Platform hardening verified 14/15 criteria on host runtime with 218/218 passing tests while container runtime is truthfully reported as unexecuted
limitations: Container runtime unexecuted due to host Docker Desktop engine daemon unavailability
